label: 911 Lite5 ac
description: MikroTik 911 Lite5 ac (RB911-5HacD) — 1x 100M RJ45, Wi-Fi 5 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core QCA9531.
notes: Power method from the mikrotik.com spec table: **PoE in: Passive PoE** (10-30 V) on `eth1`. Input is recorded on the first Ethernet port because the table states the method and voltage but does not name the port, and every MikroTik with a PoE-IN DC input takes it there. Max power consumption 7 W.
